additions.text: Pain improves with wrist kept at about typing level, resting on a pillow.

evidence.quote: i just put it on a pillow and i just let it stay straight like i feel better

follow_up_questions.question: Can you feel me touching your thumb, index and middle finger, and is the tingling getting worse? Let me check your radial pulse and capillary refill.
follow_up_questions.why: Tingling after a distal radius fracture can signal median nerve compression or vascular compromise that needs urgent attention.

follow_up_questions.question: Do you have any drug allergies, and what other medications do you take, including blood thinners or antidepressants?
follow_up_questions.why: Needed before surgery and before starting tramadol, which interacts with serotonergic drugs.

follow_up_questions.question: Did you hit your head or hurt anything else when you fell?
follow_up_questions.why: A fall on the stairs can cause other injuries that need evaluation.

follow_up_questions.question: Which is your dominant hand, and what kind of work do you do?
follow_up_questions.why: Hand dominance and occupation guide surgical planning, return to work and rehabilitation.
